inputs.description: A branch, pull request, or set of staged or unstaged changes.

outputs.description: Severity-ranked, actionable findings with file and line references.

examplePrompts: Review this pull request for correctness and regressions.
Inspect my staged changes and report only actionable findings.

inputs.description: An unfamiliar repository or component to map before modification.

outputs.description: An evidence-based map of entry points, commands, boundaries, and change sites.

examplePrompts: Map this repository before we change the authentication flow.
Find the entry points, test commands, and smallest correct edit location.

inputs.description: A repository, bounded prompt, base ref, pull-request preference, and optional hosted model.

outputs.description: A verified hosted task with task, session, model, branch, and pull-request metadata.

runtimeCompatibility.notes: Requires authenticated access to GitHub's cloud-agent API.
Requires authenticated access to GitHub's cloud-agent API.
Requires authenticated access to GitHub's cloud-agent API.

examplePrompts: Launch a GitHub Copilot cloud agent with GPT-5.6 Sol and create a pull request.
Check which model this hosted Copilot task used and report its current state.

inputs.description: A code, configuration, command, interface, or behavior change.
A request for an ADR, changelog entry, or documentation repair.

outputs.description: Accurate, runnable documentation aligned with current behavior.

examplePrompts: Update the README and changelog for this command change.
Write an ADR for the new persistence boundary.

inputs.description: A third-party skill directory or installation candidate.

outputs.description: A provenance and supply-chain assessment with an install recommendation.

examplePrompts: Audit this third-party skill before I install it.
Review this gh skill install candidate for supply-chain risk.

inputs.description: A repository with changes to branch, commit, rebase, or submit.

outputs.description: A reviewable branch, atomic commit history, or pull request.

examplePrompts: Create an atomic commit and open a pull request for these changes.
Safely rebase my unshared branch and resolve its conflicts.

inputs.description: A dependency-aware plan with safely partitioned file ownership.

outputs.description: A verified integration branch assembled from isolated worktree changes.

examplePrompts: Deliver this migration with parallel agents in isolated worktrees.
Coordinate dependency waves and integrate each branch safely.

inputs.description: An agreed specification or clearly bounded implementation request.

outputs.description: Ordered, dependency-aware tasks with acceptance criteria and verification commands.

examplePrompts: Break this approved specification into implementation tasks.
Sequence this migration and identify safely parallel work.

inputs.description: Code to restructure, simplify, rename, or prove unused.

outputs.description: A behavior-preserving structural change with dead code safely removed.

examplePrompts: Extract this module without changing behavior.
Prove this helper is unused and remove it safely.

inputs.description: A repository that needs agent instructions, profiles, or skills.

outputs.description: A minimal repository-owned agent customization structure and its files.

examplePrompts: Bootstrap AGENTS.md and repository-owned skills for this project.
Audit our agent customization and fill the smallest useful gaps.

inputs.description: An ambiguous or large feature, behavior, or design request.

outputs.description: An agreed specification with requirements, boundaries, interfaces, and rollout.

examplePrompts: Turn this feature idea into an implementation-ready specification.
Define requirements, non-goals, edge cases, and acceptance criteria.

inputs.description: A code change, endpoint, feature, or integration to review for vulnerabilities.

outputs.description: Severity-ranked vulnerabilities, threat scenarios, and concrete mitigations.

examplePrompts: Threat-model this new webhook endpoint.
Review this authentication change for exploitable vulnerabilities.

inputs.description: A .shadow graph or human-approved architecture decision to record, maintain, supersede, or render.

outputs.description: A maintained evidence-linked .shadow graph or derived view of reviewed records.

examplePrompts: Record this human-approved architecture decision in the .shadow graph.
Migrate this .shadow graph to the v2 contract without rewriting accepted history.

inputs.description: Evidence-linked current-state observations and accepted constraints for a future-state architecture question.

outputs.description: Reviewable future-state options, tradeoffs, recommendation, migration stages, rollback, and approval gate.

examplePrompts: Dream two future-state architectures from these Shadow observations and compare their migration risks.
Propose a target architecture and rollback path without treating it as approved.

inputs.description: A repository-owned .shadow graph and current implementation evidence to validate read-only.

outputs.description: Evidence-linked aligned, drifted, stale, unknown, and graph-integrity findings.

examplePrompts: Check this .shadow graph for architecture drift without repairing it.
Validate decision relations, evidence, and derived output against the implementation.

inputs.description: A bounded repository scope and architecture question for read-only current-state analysis.

outputs.description: Evidence-linked candidate observations separated into verified claims, inferences, and unknowns.

examplePrompts: Run Shadow on the authentication boundary and return candidate observations.
Map current API and persistence dependencies without creating decisions.

inputs.description: A capability, realistic trigger requests, or an existing skill to improve.

outputs.description: A validated portable skill directory with reliable routing metadata.

examplePrompts: Create a portable skill for database migration reviews.
Audit this SKILL.md and improve its routing description.

inputs.description: A bug, failing test, build error, crash, or unexpected behavior.

outputs.description: A reproduced diagnosis and verified fix for the underlying cause.

examplePrompts: Reproduce and fix this intermittent test failure.
Trace this exception to its root cause instead of patching the symptom.

inputs.description: A feature or reproducible bug whose behavior can be tested first.

outputs.description: A minimal implementation developed through a demonstrated red-green-refactor cycle.

examplePrompts: Add this behavior using red-green-refactor.
Write a failing regression test before fixing this bug.

inputs.description: A claim that work is fixed, passing, ready, or complete.

outputs.description: Fresh command or artifact evidence supporting or rejecting the claim.

examplePrompts: Verify this fix is actually complete before reporting success.
Run the relevant checks and distinguish verified results from assumptions.

inputs.description: Tests or CI validation whose green result may be weak or misleading.

outputs.description: A hardened validation design with credible assertions and enforced invariants.

examplePrompts: Audit these suspiciously green tests for vacuous assertions.
Harden this CI gate so it enforces the intended invariant.

inputs.description: A question that depends on current external APIs, releases, standards, or vulnerabilities.

outputs.description: A source-backed answer separating verified facts from inference.

examplePrompts: Research the current API behavior and cite primary sources.
Verify whether this dependency version is affected by the latest CVE.
